harm_description: False negative can place a time-critical patient in the normal queue and delay clinician assessment
existing_controls: The proposed product does not diagnose or prescribe
proposed_controls: Hard-coded emergency red flags;local external validation;uncertainty display;default to urgent review
human_oversight: On-duty nurse reviews every red flag and uncertain case within five minutes and can trigger emergency protocol
monitoring_metric: Red-flag sensitivity and under-triage near-miss count
trigger_threshold: Any confirmed under-triage or sensitivity below 99%
response_action: Stop AI queue route all intake manually notify Medical Director and perform incident review before restart

harm_description: Plausible but unsafe advice can create false reassurance and delay emergency care
existing_controls: Static emergency disclaimer and contact number
proposed_controls: Use approved red-flag rules;prohibit diagnosis;show uncertainty;one-click emergency escalation;adversarial testing
human_oversight: Nurse owns disposition and the system cannot downgrade emergency rules or close a case without review
monitoring_metric: Unsafe triage rate on approved scenario set
trigger_threshold: Any unsafe recommendation or emergency recall below 99%
response_action: Disable patient recommendation surface contact affected user if possible and revert to static emergency guidance

harm_description: A clinician may accept a harmful suggestion or inaccurate summary without checking the source data
existing_controls: Clinician is formally responsible for the care decision
proposed_controls: Separate patient facts from suggestions;highlight unsupported text;require source-data confirmation;sample audit
human_oversight: Clinician must inspect original answers acknowledge discrepancies and has authority and time to reject every suggestion
monitoring_metric: Harmful suggestion adoption rate and unverified-summary acceptance rate
trigger_threshold: Any harmful suggestion adopted or acceptance above 2%
response_action: Pause generation preserve records conduct case review retrain staff and require validated fix before resuming

high_risk_moment: Older patient self-enters symptoms on the web intake form before nurse contact
stakeholder: Người bệnh cao tuổi ít quen công nghệ
harm_description: Low digital health literacy can cause incomplete or inaccurate self-reported symptoms so the red-flag score is computed on unreliable input and under-triage risk rises
existing_controls: No alternative intake channel exists for patients who struggle with the web form; only the static emergency contact number remains available
proposed_controls: Offer phone or in-person intake support;use a large-font multilingual simplified form;flag low self-report confidence for mandatory nurse callback
human_oversight: Nurse calls back every flagged low-confidence intake within fifteen minutes before it enters the normal queue
monitoring_metric: Low self-report confidence flag rate and under-triage rate within that group
trigger_threshold: Low-confidence flag rate above 10% or any confirmed under-triage in that group
response_action: Pause automated form for the affected group route to phone intake and review the form UX design
